recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. If future issues involve the consent policy CodeSystem definitions themselves, reconcile them in HL7 Terminology/UTG rather than this core repository.
issue_request: FHIR-17598 was a Published/Persuasive CBCC technical correction for FHIR-core-many, asking editors to check an attached QA review archive; the Jira resolution was auto-approved.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit 16402e4ca905def71ad8d503e1fa421a287d04b7, titled 'QA fix to Consent GF#17598 (#20)', which corrected mojibake and an SJALL/SHALL typo in source/consent/codesystem-consent-policy.xml.
additional_context: The historical CodeSystem file was later removed from core by commit 5c0494aacfd0b8bd52bc72c587aa89d0a64246f8 during UTG terminology migration. Current core keeps Consent active/approved and references http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/consentpolicycodes from source/consent/valueset-consent-policy.xml; the current HL7 Terminology JSON contains the corrected definitions. No relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found, and the Jira attachment URL returned 403 to unauthenticated curl.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because the old core-owned CodeSystem source is gone and the current external terminology artifact already carries the correction.
